difficulty_reason: For a finitely presented morphism of affine schemes with geometrically reduced fibres, the lemma produces a Noetherian approximation in which the approximating morphism again has geometrically reduced fibres. The proof obtains the diagram from the general approximation lemma and descends the geometric reducedness condition, which is a finite-presentation condition on the fibres. Descending the reducedness condition is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 9853-9877.
